title: Penalized Fair Regression for Multiple Groups in Chronic Kidney Disease
abstract: arXiv:2512.17340v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Fair regression methods have the potential to mitigate societal bias concerns in health care, but there has been little work on penalized fair regression when multiple groups experience such bias. We propose a general regression framework that addresses this gap with unfairness penalties for multiple groups. Our approach is demonstrated for binary outcomes with true positive rate disparity penalties. It can be efficiently implemented through reduction to a cost-sensitive classification problem. We additionally introduce novel score functions for automatically selecting penalty weights. Our penalized fair regression methods are empirically studied in simulations, where they achieve a fairness-accuracy frontier beyond that of existing comparison methods. translated_title: 慢性肾病中面向多群体的惩罚化公平回归
translated_abstract: 公平回归方法有潜力缓解医疗保健领域的社会偏见问题，但当多个群体同时遭受此类偏见时，关于惩罚化公平回归的研究却十分匮乏。我们提出了一个通用的回归框架，通过对多个群体施加不公平性惩罚来填补这一空白。我们的方法在二元结果上以真阳性率差异惩罚的形式进行了展示，并可通过归约为代价敏感分类问题来高效实现。此外，我们还引入了新颖的评分函数，用于自动选择惩罚权重。我们在仿真实验中对这些惩罚化公平回归方法进行了实证研究，结果显示它们达到了超越现有对比方法的公平性-准确性边界。最后，我们将这些方法应用于一项全国多中心慢性肾病初级保健研究，以开发针对终末期肾病的公平分类器。在该研究中，我们发现子（原文摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: 提出一种面向多群体的惩罚化公平回归通用框架，通过不公平性惩罚与新颖的自动惩罚权重选择评分函数，实现高效求解，并在慢性肾病研究中取得优于现有方法的公平性-准确性平衡。
en_tdlr: We propose a general penalized fair regression framework for multiple groups, featuring unfairness penalties, efficient reduction to cost-sensitive classification, and novel score functions for automatic penalty-weight selection, achieving a fairness-accuracy frontier beyond existing methods in chronic kidney disease prediction.
